---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Incentives > Referral > Referral Program List. 

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="287" height="185" style="width: 287px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click to view a specific referral details, delete or duplicate a referral program.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="523" height="255" style="width: 523px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
